newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps upgrades Oryx Energy debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps upgrades Oryx Energy debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it upgraded Oryx Energy Co's senior debt to Double-B-Plus from Double-B and its convertible subordinated debentures to Double-B from Double-B-Minus.
The action affects about $1.2 billion of debt.

Duff & Phelps said Oryx's debt and cost-reduction program of 1995 and the improved commodity prices in 1996 improved coverage ratios in 1996. It said the company's $500 million debt reduction in 1995 meant $52 million in interest expense savings in 1996 versus 1994.
In addition, Oryx is beginning to benefit from production increases, Duff & Phelps said.

"As Oryx maintains the company's lower debt and cost structure, operating cash flows and income should continue to improve," Duff & Phelps said in a statement. "Given the improving coverage ratios and management's commitment to maintaining the financial strength of the company, DCR believes that the credit upgrade is warranted."
